help_texts.name: Internal label for this sale, never shown to customers
help_texts.type_percent: Percentage off each unit's base price
help_texts.type_fixed: Flat amount off each unit's base price
help_texts.value_fixed: Flat amount off every unit, in the shop currency
help_texts.priority: Tie-breaker when several promotions match a product with the same scope level — higher wins
help_texts.starts_at: Prices change from this moment (UTC); empty means immediately
help_texts.ends_at: Prices revert after this moment (UTC); empty means until deactivated
help_texts.is_active: Inactive promotions stop applying immediately, even within their window
help_texts.scope: All products, or an explicit selection — an empty selection can never become store-wide
help_texts.category_ids: Products in the ticked categories are promoted (exact categories, not their children)
help_texts.product_ids: Additional individual products, on top of the categories above
help_texts.preview_note: Example on a {{base}} product — the same clamping rules the storefront applies
help_texts.precedence: When several active promotions cover one product, exactly one wins: a product-level match beats a category match, which beats store-wide; ties inside a level go to higher priority, then the older promotion. Promotions never stack with each other; coupon codes still apply on top of promoted prices.
help_texts.confirm_all: This promotion will immediately change the price of EVERY product in the store while it is active. Double-check the value and the validity window before confirming.
